quirk: Gemini 0.46.0 answers session/new with -32000 carrying an account tier message, not a sign-in request: AuthRequired keeps the sign-in methods but carries the agent's own text as agentMessage. A plain Authentication required message carries none and is not prefixed twice. vertex-ai has no _meta input, so it is marked as needing environment setup instead of being offered with no input.
